title: The Road Crews Return
short_role: Trade one recovery action for stores or morale before the pressure changes.
setup: The road crews can unload field stores or steady the refuge, but either task consumes one of this interval's two actions.

choices.label: Release field stores (1 action)
choices.visible_result: Five materials reach the keep, leaving one fewer action for repair or assignment.

choices.label: Steady refuge (1 action)
choices.visible_result: The refuge steadies, leaving one fewer action for structural recovery.
